name: Undead Unluck
description: Andy, a Negator with the ability "Undead," has been long in search for someone with the ability to give him a 'real death.' Fuko Izumo brings misfortune to those around her due to her ability "Unluck." The two decide to join the Union, an organization which aims to control and protect the world from unidentified phenomena. The two uncover the mystery of the world as they search for the "greatest death ever."

videos.title: Winter Arc
videos.overview: Amidst a blizzard caused by UMA Winter, Billy receives a report on the Autumn battle and learns Undead and Unluck are evolving. Juiz appears, revealing to him that the artifacts are weapons meant to defeat God and that the Ark can only perform one more loop. She urges Billy to join forces once more and stake everything on Unluck to achieve their shared goal: "defeat God." However, Billy declares that they cannot work together. Juiz realizes Billy's true intention—to obtain Ark and Apocalypse—but before she can act, Billy drags them into a brutal clash involving UMAs on both sides. Resolute in their own "justice," Juiz presses forward with her blade, while Billy counters by utilizing other Negators' abilities and his pistol. What is Billy's true objective? Meanwhile, Andy and Fuko, having captured Autumn's core, are en route by air to take down Summer. But Billy anticipates that Juiz entrusted Apocalypse to Andy, and sends assassins to strike the pair from the skies!

videos.title: Undead and Unluck
videos.overview: An "Undead" man with an immortal body suddenly appears in front of Fuko with the power of "Unluck".

videos.title: Union
videos.overview: Andy makes a move on Fuko thinking an even greater unluck will happen.

videos.title: How to Use My Unluck
videos.overview: A Union member will be on the move for a UMA investigation. Andy and Fuko head towards Lake Baikal!

videos.title: Do You Love the Change in Me?
videos.overview: Gena thinks Fuko has stolen her long crush Andy and shows emotions of rivalry out of jealousy.

videos.title: United We Negate
videos.overview: Andy and Fuko are taken to the Roundtable where Union members await. Apocalypse delivers new quests.

videos.title: Spoil
videos.overview: Based on Union agent reports, the town of Longing had the UMA Spoil and zombies they've created.

videos.title: Dream
videos.overview: Fuko learns from the kids in the shelter about town's situation. Andy's gang join the zombie battle.

videos.title: Victhor
videos.overview: Spoil transitions to Phase 2, firing a decomposition laser for anything that gets away.

videos.title: Return
videos.overview: Victor is Andy's other face that shows up when the Card on his forehead is removed.

videos.title: Result
videos.overview: Apocalypse reads out the quest results. Failure of the sixth quest adds the UMA Galaxy as a penalty.

videos.title: Rio de Janeiro
videos.overview: The Negator Unrepair found near a black market auction, so Andy and company head over to the venue.

videos.title: Activate
videos.overview: The Union and the Negator Hunters infiltrated the black market auction.

videos.title: Tatiana
videos.overview: While Tatiana fights members of the Negator Hunters, she receives a report that Fuko was wounded by Unrepair. Tatiana unleashes her powers in order to save Fuko!

videos.title: Crimson Bullet
videos.overview: A huge explosion occurs and sends Andy and company up into the air. They find Rip among the rubble.

videos.title: Under
videos.overview: Fuko and Andy head over to right outside Chikara's school to hear his reply about joining the Union.

videos.title: Revolution
videos.overview: Apocalypse reads out the quests that have the 100th penalty on the line.

videos.title: Outsmart
videos.overview: To regain the Roundtable, the Union commences an operation with Andy and Fuko as central members.

videos.title: Cry for the Moon
videos.overview: The Union regains control of Apocalypse, but the Roundtable has been seized.

videos.title: Undead + Unluck
videos.overview: Fuko's bible in life, “To You, From Me”, may possibly be a story drawn out by an Artifact.

videos.title: Anno Un
videos.overview: Andy and Fuko are on alert and wait for Anno Un on a bench at Stanley Park in Canada.

videos.title: Memento Mori
videos.overview: Andy becomes a book thanks to Autumn's claw that Anno Un materialized.

videos.title: Profile
videos.overview: The next place Fuko arrives in the journey to learn more about Andy is Victor's memories.

videos.title: A Story I Won't See Coming
videos.overview: Anno Un's true self is Akira Kuno. Young Akira came across the Artifact, "G-Liner."

videos.title: To You, From Me
videos.overview: Andy's group and Rip's group collide in the fight with Autumn.
